property_summary: For any caller address, the deployed correct contract's owner() view always returns the stored owner (the address set during initialize via __Ownable_init), whereas the mutant returns msg.sender (i.e. equals the caller) for some callers; thus owner() must be independent of msg.sender.
For any caller, C.owner() always returns the stored owner address set during initialization; the mutant returns msg.sender so for some callers the returned address differs.

For any caller address, the deployed reference contract's owner() returns the fixed stored owner (the account set during initialization), whereas the mutant incorrectly returns msg.sender (the caller) for some callers, so owner() must be independent of who calls it.

For any caller address, C.owner() always returns the contract's stored owner (the address set during initialize) — the mutant that returns msg.sender will differ when called by an address not equal to that stored owner.

For all callers, C.owner() returns the fixed stored owner (set during initialize) — the mutant that returns msg.sender will sometimes return a different address when called by addresses other than the stored owner.
For every input the contract's paused() view returns the stored paused state (_paused) as-is; the mutant returns its negation, so there exist inputs where paused() differs (true vs false).

For any sequence of pause/unpause calls, the public paused() getter should always reflect the actual stored paused state (true when paused, false when not); the mutant returns the negation, so for some sequences the getter value differs.

For any boolean x representing the stored paused flag after any sequence of calls, C.paused() returns that stored value (true if paused, false if not); the mutant returns the negation, so for some stored states the return differs.

For every sequence of calls that leaves the contract in some stored paused state, C.paused() returns that stored boolean (true when paused, false when not); the mutant returns the negation and so will differ for at least one stored state.

For any boolean b representing the internal paused storage after any sequence of calls, C.paused() returns that stored boolean value; the mutant returns its negation so there exists a stored state (true or false) where paused() differs.

For any tokenId and after initialize, if no per-token royalty recipient is set then getRoyalties must return the global royaltyRecipient with royaltyBPS == 500; the mutant changes the default royaltyBPS to 1000 and thus will violate this for some tokenId.

For any tokenId after initialize(), if that tokenId has no per-token royaltyRecipient set then getRoyalties(tokenId) must return a RoyaltyConfiguration whose royaltyRecipient equals the global royaltyRecipient and whose royaltyBPS equals 500; the mutant changes the default royaltyBPS to 1000, violating this rule for tokenIds without per-token config.

For any tokenId after initialize(...), if that tokenId has no per-token royaltyRecipient set then getRoyalties(tokenId) must return the global royaltyRecipient and royaltyBPS == 500; the mutant returns royaltyBPS == 1000 for such tokenIds, violating this rule for some fuzzed tokenId.

After initialize(...) sets the global royaltyRecipient, for any tokenId that has no per-token royaltyRecipient configured, getRoyalties(tokenId) must return royaltyRecipient equal to the initialized global recipient and royaltyBPS == 500; the mutant changes the default royaltyBPS to 1000 and therefore will violate this rule for some tokenId values.
